notes: 12 entries whose term starts with 'Air': Air through Airborne Snow Survey Program. Keys are each entry's definition (or a distinctive part of it), because the term names nest inside one another ('Air' is in every term, 'Air Mass' is in 'Air Mass Thunderstorm', 'Air Stagnation' in 'Air Stagnation Advisory'); the term is in each label. Excluded: AIRMET (capitals, an abbreviation), and A-entries whose definition merely contains 'Air' (AFB = Air Force Base, AFWA, AOPA, ARTCC, ASR-9, ATC) because their term does not start with Air. Air Mass Thunderstorm's definition has a second paragraph ('Since all thunderstorms are associated...'); the key is its first sentence.
